items.colloc: place a backorder 下預訂單 | clear a backorder 處理延遲訂單
items.distinct: shortage 庫存短缺 | out-of-stock 缺貨
ex: The popular item is currently on backorder.
這項熱門商品目前處於延遲交貨狀態。
We will ship your backorder as soon as possible.
我們將盡快出貨您的延遲訂單。
Please wait for the backorder to be fulfilled.
請耐心等待延遲訂單完成配送。

items.colloc: order cancellation 取消訂單 | subject to cancellation 可能被取消
items.distinct: postponement 延期 | termination 終止
ex: Notice of cancellation must be sent in writing.
取消通知必須以書面形式發送。
The sudden cancellation caused a delivery delay.
突如其來的取消導致了交期延遲。
We regret the cancellation of your recent order.
對於您近期訂單的取消我們深感遺憾。

items.pos: n. 前置時間；交貨準備期
items.colloc: shorten lead-time 縮短交期 | average lead-time 平均前置時間
items.distinct: duration 持續時間 | deadline 截止日期
ex: The lead-time for this component is two weeks.
該零件的前置時間為兩週。
Long lead-times are expected during peak seasons.
旺季期間預期會有較長的前置時間。
We need to reduce lead-time to improve efficiency.
我們需要縮短前置時間以提升效率。
